summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Uni-Fuels Pte. Ltd. closed a 3M USD Commercial Paper Series 004 (UFU314) on April 17, 2026, raising US$3 million in gross proceeds. The tokens were listed on the ADDX Exchange on April 18, 2026. This is a routine debt financing activity, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate event. The filing serves as a current report of a completed non-equity capital markets transaction.
